truth_rules.current_selector: This file alone selects live operational state.
truth_rules.implementation_facts: Use live repository, PR, CI, filesystem, and tool evidence.
truth_rules.legacy_surfaces: Legacy selectors are compatibility projections or history only and may not override this file.
truth_rules.cross_program_successor_rule: Before successor selection, consult governance/application-planning/ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json. Individual program strict_successor or backlog fields cannot skip an eligible interstitial program or override cross-program gates.
truth_rules.executor_independence: Executor availability never grants or revokes project authority.
truth_rules.parallel_lane_rule: MSAS, MRCS and MVPS execute independently on distinct implementation branches and distinct lane-state refs. One lane never reserves future access to main; shared-repository publication is serialized only among immutable READY candidates.
truth_rules.protected_main_interlock: For cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app and cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc, direct main writes are prohibited. Only the FIFO READY head may merge after a green drift-sensitive integration receipt against fresh main. There is no active holder or turn_base that freezes main during implementation.
truth_rules.persistent_execution_lanes: OPS3 preserves exactly three independent persistent implementation lanes: msas, mrcs and mvps. UISR-11 is completed program history and does not occupy a persistent implementation slot.
truth_rules.no_progress_loop: Repeated owner execution commands with unchanged material_progress_seq are OPS3.NO_MATERIAL_PROGRESS and require stall diagnosis/recovery before another ordinary execution cycle.
truth_rules.generated_main_writers: CI/bots/generated-content jobs may not push directly to protected main; generated outputs must be present on the queue-bound candidate branch or validation fails closed.
truth_rules.ready_then_queue: Publication order begins only after immutable exact-head prequeue validation is green. The queue has no reservation-for-future-work, active holder, heartbeat, release, or recovery-release lifecycle.
truth_rules.lane_state_isolation: Live execution progress for persistent lanes is recorded on ops3-lane-state/msas, ops3-lane-state/mrcs and ops3-lane-state/mvps. CURRENT selects work globally; lane-state refs cannot select successors or mutate another lane.
truth_rules.executor_interruption: A chat/tool/session interruption is an executor incident, never a project lock. Resume from the last durable lane-state receipt and fresh repository/PR evidence; do not silently wait or replay completed phases.

next_project_action: Continue only the persistent implementation lane explicitly requested by the owner. MSAS-05 is selected_not_started; MRCS-04 is selected_not_started; MVPS-13 is selected_not_started. Lane execution remains independent and only immutable green READY candidates enter shared publication order.
